Title: Why You Get Morning Breath (Even If You Brushed Well)

Description:
Morning breath, if brushing before bed never even crossed your mind, pay attention — that small habit matters more than most people think. Saliva production drops sharply while you sleep, letting bacteria on your tongue build up and release odor.

Brushing and scraping your tongue right before bed, not just in the morning, can cut how strong it feels by roughly half. Mouth breathing and dehydration make it worse on top of that.

Watch to find out why, and what actually helps.
